rules.effect: You gain promotion and a reputation that keeps growing.
rules.effect_es: Obtienes un ascenso y una reputación que sigue creciendo.

rules.effect: The rivalry and enmity around you come to an end.
rules.effect_es: La rivalidad y la enemistad a tu alrededor llegan a su fin.

rules.effect: You feel drawn to charity and give generously.
rules.effect_es: Te sientes inclinado a la caridad y das con generosidad.

rules.effect: You change your place of residence and may be transferred at work.
rules.effect_es: Cambias de residencia y es posible que te trasladen en el trabajo.

rules.effect: Worries and anxieties weigh on your mind.
rules.effect_es: Las preocupaciones y la ansiedad pesan en tu mente.

rules.effect: You may find work in a service connected with law enforcement or custody.
rules.effect_es: Podrías encontrar trabajo en un servicio ligado al orden público o la custodia.

rules.effect: Your own actions end up multiplying the number of people who oppose you.
rules.effect_es: Tus propias acciones terminan multiplicando a quienes se te oponen.

rules.effect: You take on work readily but may struggle to deliver what you promised.
rules.effect_es: Aceptas trabajo con facilidad pero te puede costar cumplir lo que prometiste.

rules.effect: Old enmities come to an end.
rules.effect_es: Las viejas enemistades llegan a su fin.

rules.effect: You tend to win elections.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a ganar elecciones.

rules.effect: You tend to win legal disputes.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a ganar disputas legales.

rules.effect: You enjoy the goodwill of government officials.
rules.effect_es: Cuentas con la buena voluntad de funcionarios del gobierno.

rules.effect: You tend to gain wealth.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a ganar riqueza.

rules.effect: Children are born to you.
rules.effect_es: Llegan hijos a tu vida.

rules.effect: You gain influence and position through people in power.
rules.effect_es: Ganas influencia y posición gracias a personas con poder.

rules.effect: You benefit from the support of your superiors.
rules.effect_es: Te beneficias del apoyo de tus superiores.

rules.effect: Your efforts meet with success.
rules.effect_es: Tus esfuerzos tienen éxito.

rules.effect: Happy celebrations take place in your family.
rules.effect_es: Hay celebraciones felices en tu familia.

rules.effect: You visit holy places and take part in pilgrimages.
rules.effect_es: Visitas lugares sagrados y haces peregrinaciones.

rules.effect: You are liable to be deceived.
rules.effect_es: Eres propenso a que te engañen.

rules.effect: Enemies cause you trouble.
rules.effect_es: Los enemigos te causan problemas.

rules.effect: Dealings with the people you are drawn to turn strained.
rules.effect_es: El trato con las personas que te atraen se vuelve tenso.

rules.effect: You risk scandal and a damaged reputation through your relationships.
rules.effect_es: Corres el riesgo de escándalo y de dañar tu reputación por tus relaciones.

rules.effect: You may lose money and honour.
rules.effect_es: Puedes perder dinero y honra.

rules.effect: Your reputation may suffer.
rules.effect_es: Tu reputación puede resentirse.

rules.effect: You may drift into unhelpful company.
rules.effect_es: Puedes caer en compañías poco útiles.

rules.effect: Your letters and correspondence tend to bring discouraging news.
rules.effect_es: Tu correspondencia suele traerte noticias desalentadoras.

rules.effect: You may be transferred to a posting you do not want.
rules.effect_es: Es posible que te trasladen a un puesto que no deseas.

rules.effect: You may have to appear in court as a witness.
rules.effect_es: Puede que debas presentarte ante un tribunal como testigo.

rules.effect: You become the head of your family.
rules.effect_es: Te conviertes en la cabeza de tu familia.

rules.effect: You enjoy life.

rules.effect_es: Viajas a lugares en el extranjero.

rules.effect: You have a natural pull toward studying astrology and similar fields of insight.
rules.effect_es: Sientes una atracción natural por estudiar astrología y campos afines de conocimiento.

rules.effect: You are well suited to studying astrology.
rules.effect_es: Estás bien dotado para estudiar astrología.

rules.effect: You are enterprising and commanding, with more wish to lead than to serve.
rules.effect_es: Eres emprendedor y mandón, con más deseo de dirigir que de servir.

rules.effect: You act on your own impulses and may not take well to suggestions from others.
rules.effect_es: Actúas por tus propios impulsos y puede que no aceptes bien las sugerencias de otros.

rules.effect: You have a spiritual bent of mind.
rules.effect_es: Tienes una inclinación espiritual.

rules.effect: You are practical and careful, and set on building wealth and position.
rules.effect_es: Eres práctico y cuidadoso, y buscas construir riqueza y posición.

rules.effect: You tend to keep good health.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a conservar una buena salud.

rules.effect: You are methodical, economical and steady in the way you work.
rules.effect_es: Eres metódico, ahorrador y constante en tu forma de trabajar.

rules.effect: You are refined, intellectual and artistic in nature.
rules.effect_es: Eres refinado, intelectual y artístico por naturaleza.

rules.effect: You are suited to work where the mind is used more than the body, such as advising or writing.
rules.effect_es: Eres apto para trabajos donde se usa más la mente que el cuerpo, como asesorar o escribir.

rules.effect: You are sensitive, imaginative and receptive to your surroundings.
rules.effect_es: Eres sensible, imaginativo y receptivo a tu entorno.

rules.effect: You may have less stamina and energy than others.
rules.effect_es: Puedes tener menos resistencia y energía que otros.

rules.effect: You tend to be more fortunate in your undertakings.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a tener más suerte en tus empresas.

rules.effect: You are assertive, bold and strong-willed.
rules.effect_es: Eres asertivo, audaz y de voluntad firme.

rules.effect: You are receptive and conciliatory, more inclined to hold back than to push forward.
rules.effect_es: Eres receptivo y conciliador, más inclinado a contenerte que a empujar.

rules.effect: You hold a prominent position in trade, business, politics or your profession.
rules.effect_es: Ocupas una posición destacada en el comercio, los negocios, la política o tu profesión.

rules.effect: You are resourceful and alert, and you grasp ideas very quickly.
rules.effect_es: Eres ingenioso y atento, y captas las ideas muy rápido.

rules.effect: You are firm and self-reliant, and you rise in life through patient persistence.
rules.effect_es: Eres firme y autosuficiente, y asciendes en la vida con paciente constancia.

rules.effect: You take time to reach decisions, but in the end you succeed.
rules.effect_es: Tardas en decidirte, pero al final tienes éxito.

rules.effect: You tend to succeed with the help of others.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a tener éxito con la ayuda de otros.

rules.effect: Even when you succeed, you may not get the recognition your effort deserves.
rules.effect_es: Aun cuando tengas éxito, puede que no recibas el reconocimiento que merece tu esfuerzo.

rules.effect: You grasp ideas quickly but change your decisions just as quickly.
rules.effect_es: Captas las ideas rápido, pero cambias de decisión igual de rápido.

rules.effect: You earn money through your name and public recognition.
rules.effect_es: Ganas dinero gracias a tu nombre y al reconocimiento público.

rules.effect: Your money situation can fluctuate with the changes and risks you take.
rules.effect_es: Tu situación de dinero puede fluctuar con los cambios y riesgos que asumes.

rules.effect: You love change and travel a great deal.
rules.effect_es: Amas el cambio y viajas mucho.

rules.effect: You take readily to pioneer work and push hard for causes you believe in.
rules.effect_es: Te adaptas bien al trabajo pionero y te esfuerzas por las causas en que crees.

rules.effect: You dislike travelling and go only when circumstances force you.
rules.effect_es: No te gusta viajar y lo haces solo cuando las circunstancias te obligan.

rules.effect: You do well in secure government work or long-established organisations.
rules.effect_es: Te va bien en empleos estables del gobierno o en organizaciones con larga trayectoria.

rules.effect: You succeed through slow, steady and sustained effort.
rules.effect_es: Tienes éxito mediante un esfuerzo lento, constante y sostenido.

rules.effect: Your mind is receptive and methodical, and easily affected by your surroundings.
rules.effect_es: Tu mente es receptiva y metódica, y se ve afectada con facilidad por tu entorno.

rules.effect: You show executive ability and make progress.
rules.effect_es: Muestras capacidad ejecutiva y progresas.

rules.effect: Your friends tend to be scientifically inclined or religious.
rules.effect_es: Tus amigos tienden a ser de mentalidad científica o religiosa.

rules.effect: Some of your friends may prove unreliable.
rules.effect_es: Algunos de tus amigos pueden resultar poco confiables.

rules.effect: Friends cause you delay and hindrance.
rules.effect_es: Los amigos te causan demoras y obstáculos.

rules.effect: You may not achieve your hopes, and friends may bring you sorrow.
rules.effect_es: Puede que no logres tus esperanzas y que los amigos te causen tristeza.

rules.effect: Marriage may come later than expected for you.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio puede llegarte más tarde de lo esperado.
rules.timing_note: Book adds: provided other indications agree.

rules.effect: This stretch of your life is an especially strong window for marriage.
rules.effect_es: Esta etapa de tu vida es una ventana especialmente fuerte para el matrimonio.
rules.timing_note: Weaker significators are removed: only those strong by occupation or ownership and not tied to the opposing houses remain.

rules.effect: This stretch of your life is an especially strong window for a new job.
rules.effect_es: Esta etapa de tu vida es una ventana especialmente fuerte para un nuevo empleo.
rules.timing_note: Worked example in the book: job groups 2,6,10,11 with detrimental 1,5,9.

rules.effect: A stretch of your life led by the influence that decides your marriage prospects is when marriage is most likely.
rules.effect_es: La etapa guiada por la influencia que decide tus perspectivas de matrimonio es cuando es más probable casarse.
rules.timing_note: Book step 3: significators that are themselves the sub lords of the required houses are chosen first.

rules.effect: When you ask, the influence running this stretch is among those ruling the moment, which backs marriage in this stretch.
rules.effect_es: Cuando preguntas, la influencia de esta etapa está entre los que rigen el momento, lo que respalda el matrimonio en ella.
rules.timing_note: Question-time rule: needs a judgement moment.

rules.effect: When you ask, the influence running this stretch is among those ruling the moment, which backs a new job in this stretch.
rules.effect_es: Cuando preguntas, la influencia de esta etapa está entre los que rigen el momento, lo que respalda un nuevo empleo en ella.
rules.timing_note: Question-time rule: needs a judgement moment.

rules.effect: Your chart leaves room for a second or third partnership.
rules.effect_es: Tu carta deja espacio para una segunda o tercera pareja.

rules.effect: The arrival of children may be delayed for you.
rules.effect_es: La llegada de los hijos puede retrasarse para ti.

rules.effect: The arrival of children may be delayed for you.
rules.effect_es: La llegada de los hijos puede retrasarse para ti.

rules.effect: Twin children are possible for you.
rules.effect_es: Es posible que tengas hijos gemelos.

rules.effect: Your earnings stay shielded from sudden drains on your resources.
rules.effect_es: Tus ingresos se mantienen protegidos de pérdidas repentinas de recursos.

rules.effect: Your marriage is likely to happen in a phase that supports partnership.
rules.effect_es: Es probable que tu matrimonio ocurra en una fase que apoya la pareja.
rules.timing_note: Main-period lord must not close the door (read as: it signifies a marriage area); sub-period lord stands in the partnership cusp and is tied to the marriage areas. Book also needs it not to tie to the illness cusp through its sub lord, and transits to agree: not checked.

rules.effect: You may be transferred or moved to a new place in your job in this stretch of time.
rules.effect_es: Es posible que te trasladen o te muevan de lugar en tu trabajo en esta etapa.
rules.timing_note: Book tables use the antara, sookshma and prana lords; only the antara level is written. Star in 6 or 10 with sub in 3 or 12.

rules.effect: You may move your place of business in this stretch of time.
rules.effect_es: Es posible que cambies de lugar tu negocio en esta etapa.
rules.timing_note: Book: running period lords star in 4 or 10 with sub in 3 or 12; antara level only.

rules.effect: You may change jobs in a period that favours release and change.
rules.effect_es: Es posible que cambies de empleo en un periodo que favorece soltar y cambiar.
rules.timing_note: QUESTION-TIME rule: needs the ruling planets at the moment of asking. Book: period lords that are ruling planets and tied to 1, 5, 9; transits agree (not checked).

rules.effect: You may travel abroad on an official assignment.
rules.effect_es: Es posible que viajes al extranjero en una misión oficial.
rules.timing_note: Book: antara, sookshma and prana lords stand in the job cusps and tie to 3, 9, 12; antara level only.

rules.effect: You may choose to leave your job for good in this stretch of time.
rules.effect_es: Es posible que decidas dejar tu empleo para siempre en esta etapa.
rules.timing_note: Book: voluntary retirement in the joint period of planets tying to 6 and 10 by star and committing to 5 and 9 by sub; antara level, sub as the planet's own cusps.

rules.effect: In this stretch of time marriage can arrive together with strain between partners.
rules.effect_es: En esta etapa el matrimonio puede llegar junto con tensión entre la pareja.
rules.timing_note: Book: a planet tying to 7 by star, to 5 or 11 and also 6 by sub, with its sub-sub lord in 6 and 12; sub-sub position not checked.

rules.effect: A period whose ruler also matches the moment you ask is more likely to bring the event you ask about.
rules.effect_es: Un periodo cuyo regente coincide con el momento en que preguntas tiene más probabilidad de traer el hecho por el que preguntas.
rules.timing_note: QUESTION-TIME rule: confirmatory test only; the book says never to replace the usual steps with it.

rules.effect: Marriage is promised in your life.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio está prometido en tu vida.
rules.timing_note: Chain version (supersedes the substitute): star layer = the cusp lord's own star lord is tied to those cusps (sign, star, sub, sub-sub or occupying), sub-level layer = its own sub lord. The book's second route (linked to the partnership cusp by way of the cusp of gains) is not written.

rules.effect: Marriage is promised in your life.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio está prometido en tu vida.
rules.timing_note: Chain version (supersedes the substitute): star layer = the cusp lord's own star lord is tied to those cusps (sign, star, sub, sub-sub or occupying), sub-level layer = its own sub lord.

rules.effect: Married life may be denied to you.
rules.effect_es: Es posible que la vida matrimonial no sea parte de tu camino.
rules.timing_note: Chain version (supersedes the substitute): star layer = the cusp lord's own star lord is tied to those cusps (sign, star, sub, sub-sub or occupying), sub-level layer = its own sub lord. Book: both ruling points must tie to the opposing areas and to none of the marriage areas, even through positional status (not checked).

rules.effect: Marriage is promised to you but is likely to come late.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio está prometido para ti, pero es probable que llegue tarde.
rules.timing_note: Chain version (supersedes the substitute): star layer = the cusp lord's own star lord is tied to those cusps (sign, star, sub, sub-sub or occupying), sub-level layer = its own sub lord. First of the book's five delay conditions.

rules.effect: Marriage is promised to you but is likely to come late.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio está prometido para ti, pero es probable que llegue tarde.
rules.timing_note: Chain version (supersedes the substitute): star layer = the cusp lord's own star lord is tied to those cusps (sign, star, sub, sub-sub or occupying), sub-level layer = its own sub lord. Fourth of the book's five delay conditions (partnership cusp).

rules.effect: Marriage is promised to you but is likely to come late.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio está prometido para ti, pero es probable que llegue tarde.
rules.timing_note: Chain version: the rising cusp's sub lord is tied to the partnership cusp by its star lord and to 2, 4, 10, 12 by its own sub lord.

rules.effect: Your chart gives clear, strong support for having children.
rules.effect_es: Tu carta da un apoyo claro y firme a tener hijos.
rules.timing_note: Book (lines 137, 703, 935, 4691, 8286, 9968) wants the 5th-cusp sub lord to be a strong significator of 2/5/11, not retrograde, and not in the star of a retrograde planet. The star-of-retrograde test cannot be written; not enforced. Lines 8284-8295 say retrogression may be ignored; recorded in ledger. One rule per possible sub lord. Nodes carry no retrograde test (book never counts them retrograde).

rules.effect: You do well in business with a partner and in advisory work.
rules.effect_es: Te va bien en los negocios con un socio y en el trabajo de asesoría.
rules.timing_note: The book says "born in <sign>"; its reasoning uses house lordships counted from that sign (e.g. "Mercury owns 2 and 5 from Taurus"), so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are lucky with money and speculation, but you spend freely and find it hard to save.
rules.effect_es: Tienes suerte con el dinero y la especulación, pero gastas con libertad y te cuesta ahorrar.
rules.timing_note: The book says "born in <sign>"; its reasoning uses house lordships counted from that sign (e.g. "Mercury owns 2 and 5 from Taurus"), so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You save slowly and steadily, invest in lasting assets, and avoid speculation.
rules.effect_es: Ahorras de forma lenta y constante, inviertes en bienes duraderos y evitas la especulación.
rules.timing_note: The book says "born in <sign>"; its reasoning uses house lordships counted from that sign (e.g. "Mercury owns 2 and 5 from Taurus"), so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You make money through inventions, modern methods and patient work on novel ideas.
rules.effect_es: Ganas dinero con inventos, métodos modernos y un trabajo paciente sobre ideas novedosas.
rules.timing_note: The book says "born in <sign>"; its reasoning uses house lordships counted from that sign (e.g. "Mercury owns 2 and 5 from Taurus"), so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You do best in helping professions, and you invest safely with old age in mind.
rules.effect_es: Te va mejor en las profesiones de ayuda a los demás, e inviertes con seguridad pensando en la vejez.
rules.timing_note: The book says "born in <sign>"; its reasoning uses house lordships counted from that sign (e.g. "Mercury owns 2 and 5 from Taurus"), so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You want to lead, act quickly on your own judgment, and dislike being subordinate.
rules.effect_es: Quieres liderar, actúas con rapidez según tu propio criterio y no toleras la subordinación.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are patient and steady with strong willpower, and you care a great deal about money and comfort.
rules.effect_es: Tienes paciencia, constancia y fuerza de voluntad, y das mucha importancia al dinero y a la comodidad.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are versatile, curious and restless, and you often leave work unfinished.
rules.effect_es: Tienes versatilidad, curiosidad e inquietud, y a menudo dejas el trabajo sin terminar.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are sensitive, home-loving and changeable, but in the end you are fortunate.
rules.effect_es: Tienes sensibilidad, apego al hogar y un ánimo cambiante, pero al final la suerte te acompaña.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are generous, authoritative and dignified, and you tend to end up heading organisations.
rules.effect_es: Tienes generosidad, autoridad y dignidad, y sueles terminar al frente de organizaciones.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are methodical, critical and detail-minded, with a strong sense of order.
rules.effect_es: Tienes método, ojo crítico, atención al detalle y un fuerte sentido del orden.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are balanced and courteous, a natural peacemaker with sound judgment.
rules.effect_es: Tienes equilibrio y cortesía, una vocación natural de pacificar y buen juicio.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are determined, intense and private, and you do your best when facing obstacles.
rules.effect_es: Tienes determinación, intensidad y un lado muy reservado, y das lo mejor de ti ante los obstáculos.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are bold, truthful and philosophical, and fond of travel and higher learning.
rules.effect_es: Tienes audacia, franqueza y espíritu filosófico, y te gustan los viajes y el estudio superior.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are prudent, patient and ambitious, with a reserved and cautious manner.
rules.effect_es: Tienes prudencia, paciencia y ambición, con un trato reservado y cauteloso.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are intelligent, humane and original, and constant in friendship.
rules.effect_es: Tienes inteligencia, sentido humano y originalidad, y eres constante en la amistad.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You are romantic, kind and dreamy, and your generosity can hold back your progress.
rules.effect_es: Tienes un lado romántico, amable y soñador, y tu generosidad puede frenar tu avance.
rules.timing_note: Character section: the book speaks of "the ascendant" and "the ascendant sign afflicted" in the same paragraphs, so the sign is read as the rising sign (cusp 1).

rules.effect: You often gain luckily during a major period of intellect and dealmaking, even through a gambling streak.
rules.effect_es: A menudo ganas con suerte durante un periodo mayor de intelecto y negociación, incluso en una racha de azar.
rules.timing_note: Book: Mercury owns 2 and 5 from Taurus, so they have a gambling temperament and "often gain especially during Mercury periods". Level of period not stated; major period used.

rules.effect: You tend to gain from speculation, and you are lucky in vehicles, home, business and your partner.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a ganar con la especulación, y tienes suerte con los vehículos, el hogar, los negocios y la pareja.
rules.timing_note: Book: "in speculation they will invariably gain as lord of 2 is also lord of 5"; also "always lucky in anything they want - vehicle, wife, business, house".

rules.effect: Speculation tends not to pay for you, because the ruler of pleasure and risk also rules loss.
rules.effect_es: La especulación suele no rendirte frutos, porque el regente del placer y del riesgo también rige la pérdida.
rules.timing_note: Book: "Speculation will not be helpful to Sagittarians, as lord of 5 is also lord of 12".

rules.effect: You give your home comfort, harmony and good food, and you keep it tidy and well maintained.
rules.effect_es: Das a tu hogar comodidad, armonía y buena comida, y lo mantienes ordenado y en buen estado.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: Your home is busy with visitors, you decorate it in a modern style, and you will move until you find a place you like.
rules.effect_es: Tu casa está llena de visitas, la decoras con estilo moderno y te mudarás hasta encontrar un lugar que te guste.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: You are devoted to your family, find your pleasure at home and in the garden, and like to keep old things.
rules.effect_es: Te dedicas a tu familia, encuentras tu placer en casa y en el jardín, y te gusta conservar cosas antiguas.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: You lead at home and expect cooperation, and you spend freely on dress, furnishings and an impressive home to keep up your prestige.
rules.effect_es: Lideras en casa y esperas cooperación, y gastas con libertad en ropa, muebles y un hogar imponente para mantener tu prestigio.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: You like everything orderly at home, you entertain more than you visit, and you tend to change residence often.
rules.effect_es: Te gusta todo en orden en casa, recibes más de lo que visitas y tiendes a cambiar de residencia con frecuencia.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: Your family life is peaceful, with a well-furnished home, tasteful decoration and many comforts.
rules.effect_es: Tu vida familiar es tranquila, con un hogar bien amueblado, decoración de buen gusto y muchas comodidades.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: You want your wishes followed at home and need comfort, you spend beyond your means, yet you turn hard times to your advantage.
rules.effect_es: Quieres que se cumplan tus deseos en casa y necesitas comodidad, gastas por encima de tus medios, pero conviertes las épocas difíciles en ventaja.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: You spend generously on children or good causes, yet you may feel you lack the independence you want at home.
rules.effect_es: Gastas con generosidad en los hijos o en buenas causas, pero puedes sentir que te falta la independencia que quieres en casa.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: You collect beautiful things and value quiet and privacy at home, and you rarely show your love openly, so family may misread you.
rules.effect_es: Coleccionas cosas hermosas y valoras la calma y la privacidad en casa, y rara vez muestras tu amor abiertamente, así que la familia puede malinterpretarte.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: You keep a tidy, modern, well-furnished home, enjoy gadgets and antiques, and like both solitude and company.
rules.effect_es: Mantienes un hogar ordenado, moderno y bien amueblado, disfrutas los aparatos y las antigüedades, y te gustan tanto la soledad como la compañía.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: You welcome many friends who comfort you, want educated children and partner, and value a loving home life.
rules.effect_es: Recibes a muchas amistades que te consuelan, deseas hijos y pareja instruidos, y valoras una vida de hogar cariñosa.
rules.timing_note: Section "Domestic environment" by sign; the Virgo paragraph reasons with house lordships, so the sign is read as the rising sign.

rules.effect: You are lucky in finding good homes to live in, and you tend to buy property in a good locality.
rules.effect_es: Tienes suerte para encontrar buenas viviendas, y tiendes a comprar propiedades en una buena zona.

rules.effect: Property and investments tend to gain value in this period, so it is a good time to sell holdings.
rules.effect_es: La propiedad y las inversiones tienden a ganar valor en este periodo, así que es buen momento para vender tus activos.
rules.timing_note: Book: value of property shoots up in the period of Jupiter; it is advisable for Virgoans to dispose of holdings then. Period level not stated; major period used.

rules.effect: Investments tend to lose value in this joint period, and holdings kept from before may have to be sold at a loss.
rules.effect_es: Las inversiones tienden a perder valor en este periodo conjunto, y lo que conservabas puede tener que venderse con pérdida.
rules.timing_note: Book: losses in investments "during the joint periods of Saturn and Mars"; order of the two not stated, so this rule and the next cover both orders.

rules.effect: Investments tend to lose value in this joint period, and holdings kept from before may have to be sold at a loss.
rules.effect_es: Las inversiones tienden a perder valor en este periodo conjunto, y lo que conservabas puede tener que venderse con pérdida.
rules.timing_note: Order-swapped twin of the previous rule.

rules.effect: Your partner is likely to be religious, law-abiding and true, which gives you a peaceful home life.
rules.effect_es: Es probable que tu pareja sea religiosa, respetuosa de la ley y sincera, lo que te da una vida de hogar tranquila.

rules.effect: You are frank, ambitious and dignified, with quick perception, vitality and a love of authority.
rules.effect_es: Eres de trato directo, con ambición y dignidad, rapidez de percepción, vitalidad y amor por la autoridad.

rules.effect: You gain through investments and creative pursuits, and money also comes through your own industry, your father or the government.
rules.effect_es: Ganas con inversiones y actividades creativas, y el dinero también llega por tu propio esfuerzo, tu padre o el gobierno.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: Success grows after marriage, and partnerships, contracts and people of high standing work in your favour.
rules.effect_es: El éxito crece después del matrimonio, y las sociedades, los contratos y las personas de alto rango te favorecen.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You enjoy a good understanding with your partner but may have friction with your children and spend heavily on partnerships.
rules.effect_es: Disfrutas de buen entendimiento con tu pareja, pero puedes tener fricciones con tus hijos y gastar mucho en sociedades.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You are imaginative, independent and courageous, a little restless, fond of travel and devoted to your mother.
rules.effect_es: Tienes imaginación, independencia y valentía, algo de inquietud, afición a viajar y devoción por tu madre.
rules.timing_note: Book adds that all of this comes true if the sub lord of the Moon is a benefic.

rules.effect: Your property and fixed assets are tied to your children's fortunes, and you may live near a school, garden, theatre or playground.
rules.effect_es: Tu propiedad y tus bienes fijos están ligados a la suerte de tus hijos, y puedes vivir cerca de una escuela, un jardín, un teatro o un parque.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You gain through valuable possessions, land and property, farming, gardens and educational work.
rules.effect_es: Ganas con posesiones valiosas, tierras y propiedades, la agricultura, los jardines y el trabajo educativo.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You may gain land or property through marriage, and your partner may have a career of their own.
rules.effect_es: Puedes ganar tierras o propiedades por medio del matrimonio, y tu pareja puede tener una carrera propia.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You are energetic, assertive and combative, want to be at the head, and prefer to cut your own path in life.
rules.effect_es: Tienes energía, firmeza y espíritu combativo, quieres estar al frente y prefieres abrir tu propio camino en la vida.

rules.effect: You are very active and dominant, with real executive ability.
rules.effect_es: Tienes mucha actividad y dominio, con una verdadera capacidad ejecutiva.

rules.effect: Money becomes a main concern for you, and effort brings material success, including gains from a partner's money or recovered debts.
rules.effect_es: El dinero se vuelve una preocupación central para ti, y el esfuerzo trae éxito material, incluidos ingresos del dinero de tu pareja o deudas cobradas.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: Associations matter to you, you enjoy company, and your partner may be well off.
rules.effect_es: Las asociaciones importan para ti, disfrutas la compañía y tu pareja puede tener buena posición económica.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You delight in pleasure, theatre, outdoor sports and speculation, and your first child supports you.
rules.effect_es: Disfrutas el placer, el teatro, los deportes al aire libre y la especulación, y tu primer hijo te apoya.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You are quick-witted, good at speaking and writing, and enthusiastic, though you may lack a steady method.
rules.effect_es: Tienes agudeza, habilidad para hablar y escribir y entusiasmo, aunque puede faltarte un método constante.

rules.effect: You have mechanical and constructive ability, adaptability, an inquiring mind and a love of books.
rules.effect_es: Tienes habilidad mecánica y constructiva, adaptabilidad, una mente inquisitiva y amor por los libros.

rules.effect: Money can come through communication, transport, travel, sales and persuasion, and through mail-order style business.
rules.effect_es: El dinero puede llegar por la comunicación, el transporte, los viajes, las ventas y la persuasión, y por negocios a distancia.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: Money may come through service work, borrowed funds and healthcare-related work, and from reimbursed medical costs.
rules.effect_es: El dinero puede llegar por trabajo de servicio, fondos prestados y labores relacionadas con la salud, y por gastos médicos reembolsados.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: Your marriage or a business partner may come through an advertisement or while you are travelling.
rules.effect_es: Tu matrimonio o un socio de negocios puede llegar por un anuncio o durante un viaje.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: Your pleasures lean towards the mind: you enjoy books, films and mental rather than physical romance.
rules.effect_es: Tus placeres se inclinan hacia la mente: disfrutas los libros, el cine y un romance más mental que físico.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You are generous, candid and high-minded, optimistic and well respected, and you may pioneer in religion, philosophy, writing or law.
rules.effect_es: Tienes generosidad, franqueza y nobleza de ideas, optimismo y respeto de los demás, y puedes abrir camino en religión, filosofía, escritura o derecho.

rules.effect: You receive timely help and a good education, and you may grow into politics, law, banking or healing work.
rules.effect_es: Recibes ayuda oportuna y una buena educación, y puedes crecer en la política, el derecho, la banca o el trabajo de sanación.

rules.effect: You gain through your father, his good name or his line of work, and through dealings with outsiders.
rules.effect_es: Ganas por medio de tu padre, su buen nombre o su oficio, y por tratos con personas ajenas.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You may gain through behind-the-scenes activity, a pen name or dealing in antiques.
rules.effect_es: Puedes ganar con actividades discretas, un seudónimo o el comercio de antigüedades.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: Your father has a say in your business or is a partner in it, and long journeys may cost you, while your partner may travel often.
rules.effect_es: Tu padre opina en tu negocio o es socio, los viajes largos pueden costarte, y tu pareja puede viajar con frecuencia.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You are inclined to study science, law, philosophy, research or religion.
rules.effect_es: Te inclinas por el estudio de la ciencia, el derecho, la filosofía, la investigación o la religión.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You may lose money in speculation, which upsets your finances, and carry secret worries over love affairs or risky ventures.
rules.effect_es: Puedes perder dinero en la especulación, lo que altera tus finanzas, y llevar preocupaciones ocultas por amoríos o aventuras arriesgadas.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You enjoy vehicles, decorative arts, music, painting and romance, have many friends, and are popular and generous with gifts.
rules.effect_es: Disfrutas los vehículos, las artes decorativas, la música, la pintura y el romance, tienes muchas amistades, gozas de popularidad y regalas con generosidad.

rules.effect: You are amiable, cheerful and affectionate, fond of company, with artistic and dramatic aptitude, and you are admired by others.
rules.effect_es: Tienes un trato amable, alegre y afectuoso, gusto por la compañía, aptitud artística y dramática, y la admiración de los demás.

rules.effect: You earn through your own ingenuity and industry, and you take a keen interest in financial matters.
rules.effect_es: Ganas con tu propio ingenio y esfuerzo, y te interesas mucho por los asuntos financieros.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You gain through marriage, a business partner and public dealings, and sometimes suddenly from legal matters.
rules.effect_es: Ganas por medio del matrimonio, un socio y el trato con el público, y a veces de forma repentina en asuntos legales.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You marry into a good family and gain an attractive partner, though the partner may grow cold or distant.
rules.effect_es: Te casas en una buena familia y tienes una pareja atractiva, aunque la pareja puede volverse fría o distante.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You can succeed in speculation and love affairs, and in vocal music.
rules.effect_es: Puedes tener éxito en la especulación, en los amoríos y en el canto.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: Marriage or a partnership may bring legal disputes, and you may go into business with your first child.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio o una sociedad puede traer disputas legales, y puedes asociarte en negocios con tu primer hijo.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You meet obstacles often along the way.
rules.effect_es: Encuentras obstáculos con frecuencia en tu camino.
rules.timing_note: Book also says marriage is delayed, since Saturn faces the 7th house; the delay is already covered by an earlier rule.

rules.effect: Your profession and work for the government bring you heavy gains.
rules.effect_es: Tu profesión y el trabajo para el gobierno te traen grandes ganancias.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You may see a financial windfall, a promotion and benefits through friends.
rules.effect_es: Puedes ver una ganancia inesperada, un ascenso y beneficios por medio de amistades.
rules.timing_note: Book section "Planetary behaviour in Aries lagna": a planet in the star of the lord of house N is read "as if in N" (planet-lord combinations as the book lists them). Written for a rising Aries only, as the book illustrates.

rules.effect: You make an honourable marriage to a well-known, highly educated partner, though friction in the marriage is hard to remove.

Strong = levels (a) and (b), i.e. max_level 2. The ranking says which significators act first; applying it to the marriage timing is the reader's step.

rules.effect: This is a period when marriage or a lasting partnership is likely to happen for you.
rules.effect_es: Es un periodo en el que es probable que te cases o formes una pareja duradera.
rules.timing_note: Book: main, sub and sub-sub period lords must each signify the marriage houses AND the transit must agree (transiting planets standing in stars whose lords signify those houses, worked example lines 1788-1812). Transit-by-star-lord is not testable; only the three period lords are. Where a period lord reaches the houses only by conjunction with a signifying planet (line 1693-1697) this is not captured.

rules.effect: This is a period when an engagement or a formal agreement toward marriage is likely.
rules.effect_es: Es un periodo en el que es probable un compromiso o un acuerdo formal rumbo al matrimonio.
rules.timing_note: Book says betrothal happens in the periods of the houses for agreement and the opposite party, with transit agreeing (worked example Sun-Mars-Saturn, lines 1769-1778). Which period levels must agree is not spelled out; all three are required here.

rules.effect: This is a period when the birth of a child is likely for you.
rules.effect_es: Es un periodo en el que es probable que nazca un hijo o una hija.
rules.timing_note: Book uses the houses for addition of a member, child birth and fulfilment, in the main, sub and sub-sub periods, with transit support (lines 5974-5989, 6299-6320).

rules.effect: This is a period when your earnings and income are likely to do well.
rules.effect_es: Es un periodo en el que es probable que tus ingresos vayan bien.
rules.timing_note: Book: if the wealth houses are linked, one earns well in the periods of the planets signifying them. Whether the chart has the houses linked is not tested.

rules.effect: This is a period when tension or separation in a close partnership is more likely.
rules.effect_es: Es un periodo en el que son más probables la tensión o la separación en una relación cercana.
rules.timing_note: Book: separation is read from the houses of self, service, profession and loss when the period lords signify them (lines 3037-3041, 3267-3269, 4665-4684); it also wants those houses linked to the marriage houses (line 3334). Applies only to a person who is in a partnership. Legal separation is tied to Jupiter periods (line 3043-3046), not coded.

rules.effect: Your chart leaves room for a second marriage or a second long-term partnership.
rules.effect_es: Tu carta deja espacio para un segundo matrimonio o una segunda pareja a largo plazo.
rules.timing_note: Book names Jupiter or the seventh-house lord; only Jupiter is testable. Second marriage is judged from the ninth house (the third from the seventh) together with the seventh and eleventh.

rules.effect: Your marriage is likely to grow out of a love relationship.
rules.effect_es: Es probable que tu matrimonio nazca de una relación de amor.
rules.timing_note: Book: a link between the houses of romance and marriage gives a love marriage if the periods and transit support. The link can be through any planet; only Jupiter (a marriage planet, line 4627) is tested here.

rules.effect: Your marriage is likely to grow out of a love relationship.

rules.effect: Your chart supports marriage taking place in your life.
rules.effect_es: Tu carta apoya que el matrimonio se dé en tu vida.

rules.effect: Your relationship can grow into a love marriage that you choose yourself.
rules.effect_es: Tu relación puede convertirse en un matrimonio por amor que tú eliges.

rules.effect: A romance you are in can lead all the way to marriage.
rules.effect_es: Un romance en el que estés puede llegar hasta el matrimonio.

rules.effect: A love relationship is likely to end in marriage.
rules.effect_es: Una relación amorosa tiene buenas probabilidades de terminar en matrimonio.

rules.effect: A romantic partner may pull back once marriage is raised.
rules.effect_es: Tu pareja romántica podría retroceder cuando se plantee el matrimonio.

rules.effect: You yourself may drop the idea of marrying for love.
rules.effect_es: Podrías abandonar tú la idea de casarte por amor.

rules.effect: Marriage is promised but may come late or after obstacles.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio está prometido, pero puede llegar tarde o tras obstáculos.

rules.effect: Marriage looks unlikely for you; this part of your chart works against it.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio parece poco probable para ti; esta parte de tu carta va en contra.

rules.effect: Your marriage may go through a period of separation or serious conflict.
rules.effect_es: Tu matrimonio podría pasar por una etapa de separación o de conflicto serio.

rules.effect: A serious rift or divorce becomes possible in your marriage.
rules.effect_es: Una ruptura seria o un divorcio es posible en tu matrimonio.

rules.effect: Everyday harmony in your marriage can be hard to keep; quarrels are likely.
rules.effect_es: La armonía cotidiana en tu matrimonio puede ser difícil de mantener; son probables las discusiones.

rules.effect: Satisfaction and ease in your married life may be hard to find.
rules.effect_es: La satisfacción y la tranquilidad en tu vida matrimonial pueden ser difíciles de encontrar.

rules.effect: Your married life may lack warmth and family closeness.
rules.effect_es: Tu vida matrimonial podría carecer de calidez y cercanía familiar.

rules.effect: You may marry more than once.
rules.effect_es: Podrías casarte más de una vez.

rules.effect: A second marriage is possible for you.
rules.effect_es: Un segundo matrimonio es posible para ti.

rules.effect: Your partner may have been married before, or may marry more than once.
rules.effect_es: Tu pareja podría haber estado casada antes, o casarse más de una vez.

rules.effect: You may marry someone from outside your own community.
rules.effect_es: Podrías casarte con alguien ajeno a tu propia comunidad.

rules.effect: Your marriage plans may face a postponement, a delay or a last-minute change.
rules.effect_es: Tus planes de matrimonio podrían enfrentar un aplazamiento, un retraso o un cambio de último momento.
rules.timing_note: The book says results are not uniform; the only certain thing is some problem in the marriage.

rules.timing_note: Book adds the condition that Saturn or Moon is a significator of the matter; not enforced here. Sub-period = Vimshottari antardasha.

rules.effect_es: Es posible que el matrimonio no llegue a darse con esta configuración.

rules.effect: This is a strong window for marriage; the long, middle and short periods running now all point towards it.

rules.effect: A stretch supportive of marriage is running now; the exact timing narrows down within it.
rules.effect_es: Está en marcha una etapa favorable al matrimonio; el momento exacto se define dentro de ella.
rules.timing_note: Book: the long period gives the trend, the middle one narrows it to months, the short one fixes it.

rules.effect: This is a likely window for a love marriage.
rules.effect_es: Esta es una ventana probable para un matrimonio por amor.
rules.timing_note: House set 2,5,7,11 for love marriage; one passage (line 3591) adds house 1, another (line 3754) allows first-house significators too.

rules.effect: Your chart supports having children.

rules.timing_note: Book also requires the sub lord to be non-retrograde and not in the star of a retrograde planet (line 935); it later says retrograde may be ignored (line 8291). Not expressible.

rules.effect: Your chart gives a further sign of support for children.
rules.effect_es: Tu carta da una señal adicional de apoyo a tener hijos.

rules.effect: Your wish for a child is likely to be fulfilled.

rules.effect: A child is likely to arrive in this window; all three layers of your current period point to it.

rules.effect: A stretch supportive of having a child is running now.
rules.effect_es: Está en marcha una etapa favorable para tener un hijo.

rules.effect: Having children is supported, provided other signs agree.
rules.effect_es: Tener hijos cuenta con apoyo, siempre que otras señales coincidan.
rules.timing_note: Book lists three watery signs; only the one owned by Moon can be separated by a sign lord test. The author calls this rule too general (line 102).

rules.effect: You come across as smart and well presented.

rules.effect_es: Tus impulsos ambiciosos tienden a traer resultados indeseables.
rules.timing_note: Book says Rahu in the constellation of the lords of the 6th, 8th or 12th gives undesirable results even if it sits in a helpful house. 'Star lord signifies' is used as a proxy for 'star lord is the owner of'.

rules.effect: Your home life can turn tense, with quarrels and growing mistrust.
rules.effect_es: Tu vida en casa puede volverse tensa, con discusiones y desconfianza creciente.
rules.timing_note: Rahu in Sun's constellation. Book says the troubles are strongest when Sun rules unhelpful houses.

rules.effect: You are likely to change your line of work and your place of residence.
rules.effect_es: Es probable que cambies de ocupación y de lugar de residencia.

rules.effect: You may feel mental unrest and run into enmity around you.

rules.effect: Your income tends to rise.
rules.effect_es: Tus ingresos tienden a aumentar.
rules.timing_note: Rahu in Moon's constellation. Book adds that results change when that star lord rules unhelpful houses or is afflicted; that condition is not tested here.

rules.effect: You enjoy a pleasant life among relatives and loved ones.

rules.timing_note: Rahu in Moon's constellation. Book adds that results change when that star lord rules unhelpful houses or is afflicted; that condition is not tested here.

rules.effect: You do well in farming and land-based work, with a good yield.

rules.effect: You risk financial losses.

rules.timing_note: Rahu in Mars's constellation. Book says the picture turns favourable if Mars is a helpful planet by lordship; that is not tested here.

rules.effect: You may lose out in a legal dispute.
rules.effect_es: Puedes salir perdiendo en una disputa legal.
rules.timing_note: Rahu in Mars's constellation. Book says the picture turns favourable if Mars is a helpful planet by lordship; that is not tested here.

rules.effect_es: Esta etapa de tu vida te acerca a volver a casa.
rules.timing_note: Book lists 'Returning to home' as 3, 9, 11 with no primary house, so no promise test is applied.

rules.effect: Your life holds a firm promise of marriage.
rules.effect_es: Tu vida tiene una promesa firme de matrimonio.
rules.timing_note: Book: if the sub lord of the 7th cusp signifies the 7th, 2nd or 11th, marriage is promised and the person will definitely marry.

rules.effect: Marriage is unlikely to come about in your life.
rules.effect_es: Es poco probable que el matrimonio se dé en tu vida.
rules.timing_note: Book: if the sub lord signifies only the detrimental houses (the 12th from each group house: 1, 6, 10) and none of 2, 7, 11, the matter will not fructify. The book calls the 12th-house rule general but says it needs modification with evidence.

rules.effect: Marriage can come, and so can strain or separation, at different times in your life.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio puede llegar, y también la tensión o la separación, en momentos distintos de tu vida.
rules.timing_note: Book: if the sub lord signifies both the group and the detrimental houses, both results come in different periods.

rules.effect: This stretch of your life moves you closer to getting a new job.
rules.effect_es: Esta etapa de tu vida te acerca a conseguir un nuevo empleo.
rules.timing_note: Group given in the worked example: for a new job judge 2, 6, 10 and 11.

rules.effect: This stretch of your life moves you closer to entering service.
rules.effect_es: Esta etapa de tu vida te acerca a empezar a trabajar en un empleo.
rules.timing_note: Table: service = 2, 6, 10. The book states no primary house here, so no promise test is applied; compare the other group for service/business (6, 7) in the house-grouping page.

rules.effect: This stretch of your life moves you closer to gaining money.
rules.effect_es: Esta etapa de tu vida te acerca a ganar dinero.
rules.timing_note: Table: gain of money = 2, 6, 11; no primary house stated.

rules.effect: This stretch of your life moves you closer to progressing in your education.
rules.effect_es: Esta etapa de tu vida te acerca a avanzar en tu educación.
rules.timing_note: Table: education = 4, 9, 11; no primary house stated (the house-grouping page gives 4 with 11 for basic education and 9 with 11 for higher).

rules.effect: This stretch of your life moves you closer to welcoming the birth of a child.
rules.effect_es: Esta etapa de tu vida te acerca a recibir el nacimiento de un hijo.
rules.timing_note: Table: child birth = 2, 5, 11; no primary house stated.

rules.effect: This stretch of your life moves you closer to travelling abroad.
rules.effect_es: Esta etapa de tu vida te acerca a viajar al extranjero.
rules.timing_note: Table: foreign travel = 3, 9, 12; no primary house stated.

rules.effect: You are naturally drawn to higher learning, philosophy and the study of hidden or spiritual subjects.
rules.effect_es: Te atraen de forma natural el estudio superior, la filosofía y el estudio de temas ocultos o espirituales.
rules.timing_note: Book gives this as a requirement for a successful astrologer; the effect is stated here as the aptitude only.

rules.effect: You feel a strong desire to learn astrology.
rules.effect_es: Sientes un fuerte deseo de aprender astrología.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'Saturn and Moon in 1, 3, 9 or 10'; read as both planets in the KP cusp houses listed.

rules.effect: You are likely to study ancient learned texts and deep subjects in some depth.
rules.effect_es: Es probable que estudies textos antiguos y temas profundos con detenimiento.
rules.timing_note: '7th from the 2nd' written as house 8. Book says 'strong significator of the 2nd'; strength cannot be written, plain significator used. Type of learning depends on the planets (not expressed).

rules.effect: You can become a skilled practitioner of astrology or the hidden sciences.
rules.effect_es: Puedes llegar a ser un practicante experto de la astrología o de las ciencias ocultas.
rules.timing_note: Book says the sub lord 'aspects or becomes' a significator of 9 or 12; only the significator route is written (aspect of a cusp by longitude is not in the grammar).

rules.effect: You are suited to work as an editor or publisher.
rules.effect_es: Eres apto para trabajar como editor o publicador.
rules.timing_note: Ambiguous in the book (each planet signifying any of 2, 10, 11 vs. together covering them); read as each.

rules.effect: You are suited to work as a journalist.
rules.effect_es: Eres apto para trabajar como periodista.
rules.timing_note: Book: 'Jupiter and Mercury, significators of 3 and 9'; read as each signifying 3 or 9.

rules.effect: You can concentrate deeply and settle into meditation with ease.
rules.effect_es: Puedes concentrarte profundamente y entrar en meditación con facilidad.
rules.timing_note: Book states the general case as the ascendant sub lord and the sub lord of the Moon being one and the same planet, then names Saturn; only the Saturn case is written.

rules.effect: You find it even easier to meditate and keep your mind steady.
rules.effect_es: Te resulta aún más fácil meditar y mantener la mente serena.

rules.effect: Important matters meet obstacles and delays, and often succeed only after more than one attempt.
rules.effect_es: Los asuntos importantes encuentran obstáculos y demoras, y a menudo solo salen bien después de más de un intento.
rules.timing_note: 'Punarpoo' variant: Moon in the sub of Saturn.

rules.effect: Important matters meet obstacles and delays, and often succeed only after more than one attempt.
rules.effect_es: Los asuntos importantes encuentran obstáculos y demoras, y a menudo solo salen bien después de más de un intento.
rules.timing_note: 'Punarpoo' variant: Saturn in the sub of Moon.

rules.effect: Things you hope for arrive slowly, after delay.
rules.effect_es: Lo que esperas llega despacio y con demora.
rules.timing_note: Book: lord of 11 (or occupant) shows sooner or later; Saturn as owner delays. Cusp sign lord used for 'owner of 11' (KP defines no house lords).

rules.effect: The fulfilment of your wishes is delayed, so patience is needed.
rules.effect_es: El cumplimiento de tus deseos se retrasa, así que necesitas paciencia.
rules.timing_note: Book adds that if Rahu occupies the 11th owned by Saturn, the delay lasts only until Rahu's sub-period (not expressed).

rules.effect: Marriage is promised for you; it is likely to happen at some point in your life.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio está prometido para ti; es probable que ocurra en algún momento de tu vida.
rules.timing_note: Book names the 7th cusp as principal house here, the earlier list names the 11th cusp (see ledger). Significator rank (star of occupant, occupant, star of lord, lord, conjunct/aspected) is not graded.

rules.effect: This is a period when marriage or a lasting partnership is likely to come about.
rules.effect_es: Este es un periodo en el que es probable que llegue un matrimonio o una unión duradera.
rules.timing_note: Book: a promised matter materialises in the joint period of the significators of the relevant houses, with a favourable transit; the three levels together should cover houses 2, 7, 11 (not enforced as a union) and transit agreement is not checked.

rules.effect: This is a period when the birth of a child is likely.
rules.effect_es: Este es un periodo en el que es probable el nacimiento de un hijo.
rules.timing_note: From a worked example: dasha, bhukti and anthra lords all significators of houses 2 and 5 (11 for men). No natal promise clause is given in this passage; Vol 3 lists cusp 5 sub lord for child birth with a retrograde caveat.

rules.effect: This is a period when the birth of a child is likely.
rules.effect_es: Este es un periodo en el que es probable el nacimiento de un hijo.
rules.timing_note: Houses 2, 5 and 11 for a man ('11th is important for gents'); same caveat as the female rule.

rules.effect: This is a period when taking up a job or service is likely.
rules.effect_es: Este es un periodo en el que es probable que empieces un empleo o servicio.
rules.timing_note: Worked example: 'houses 2, 6 and 10 denote the service' with dasha, bhukti, anthra lords signifying them. Loose rule: fires often; Vol 3 adds cusp 10 sub lord and a direct-motion condition not expressible.

rules.effect: Marriage is promised in your life, supported by family and lasting close ties.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio está prometido en tu vida, respaldado por la familia y por vínculos cercanos duraderos.
rules.timing_note: Book: the 7th cusp sub lord, through its star lord and sub lord, must signify houses 2 and 11 for marriage to be promised.

rules.effect: Marriage is likely to take place during this period.
rules.effect_es: Es probable que el matrimonio se dé durante este periodo.
rules.timing_note: Book speaks of the period of a planet signifying 2, 7 and 11; the same logic is used at dasha and antara level in the worked charts (lines 7177, 6895).

rules.effect: Proposals may come and go one after another without a wedding actually taking place.

rules.timing_note: Book gives this as the contrast to the promise rule; the 'signifies none of 2 and 11' clause is added from its 'only if' logic.

rules.effect: Marriage plans are likely to meet obstacles and delays, from negotiation through fixing the date to the ceremony.

rules.effect: Your wedding may be put off for a long time, until you feel disheartened.
rules.effect_es: Tu boda puede posponerse por mucho tiempo, hasta que te sientas desanimado.

rules.timing_note: Book: delays every time in fixing marriage but does not deny marital happiness. Same passage says Saturn that only aspects these houses points to denial; that half could not be written.

rules.effect: In this sub-period wedding plans tend to stall, and they usually move forward in the next period.
rules.effect_es: En este subperiodo los planes de boda tienden a estancarse y suelen avanzar en el siguiente periodo.
rules.timing_note: Book says the event will not happen until Saturn's bhukti or anthara is over, then in the following planet's period if that planet signifies the event; the antara (pd) level applies too.

rules.effect: In this sub-period wedding plans tend to stall, and they usually move forward in the next period.

rules.timing_note: Same as the previous rule, for the Moon-in-Saturn's-star variant of the dosha.

rules.effect: Even when your income should rise, unexpected expenses and mental tension can cancel the gain.

rules.effect: Marriage may be denied, break down or end in separation.

rules.effect_es: El matrimonio es incierto para ti, porque la carta no lo promete con claridad.

rules.effect: Marriage tends to happen when your running time periods all point to family, partnership and gain together.
rules.effect_es: El matrimonio suele ocurrir cuando tus periodos de tiempo en curso apuntan juntos a familia, pareja y ganancia.
rules.timing_note: Book adds: the exact day comes from transits of the period lords through the star and sub of the significators, and ruling planets filter which significators fructify (not expressible).

rules.effect: Your marriage may be delayed at several stages, but the delay does not mean denial.

rules.effect: Your marriage is likely to come later than usual.
rules.effect_es: Es probable que tu matrimonio llegue más tarde de lo habitual.

rules.effect_es: Tu carta favorece tener hijos.

rules.effect: Your chart supports having children.
rules.effect_es: Tu carta favorece tener hijos.

rules.timing_note: Book says 3 or 9 or 12, preferably 9 (line 2817); a later passage says the sub lord must signify 3 and 9 (line 6851). Minor conflict, the looser form is used.

rules.effect: You may go abroad for work or a job.
rules.effect_es: Puedes irte al extranjero por trabajo o empleo.

rules.timing_note: Book: income 2, service 6, profession 10; gain 11 also appears in its worked case.

rules.effect_es: Un ascenso suele llegar cuando tu subperiodo en curso apunta a la vez a carrera y ganancia.
rules.timing_note: Book warns the same combination can also bring unwelcome news about a parent (not recorded).

rules.effect: Your job may be at risk when a sub-period tied to both creative effort and loss is running.
rules.effect_es: Tu empleo puede correr riesgo cuando corre un subperiodo ligado a la vez al esfuerzo creativo y a la pérdida.

rules.effect: Your work is likely tied to government, authority or institutions.
rules.effect_es: Tu trabajo probablemente se relaciona con el gobierno, la autoridad o las instituciones.
rules.timing_note: Book reads the nature of the job from the sign, star and sub lords of the tenth cusp together.

rules.effect: Your work is likely tied to machinery, engineering or technical skills.
rules.effect_es: Tu trabajo probablemente se relaciona con maquinaria, ingeniería o habilidades técnicas.

rules.effect: Your work is likely tied to paper, writing, communication or trade.
rules.effect_es: Tu trabajo probablemente se relaciona con el papel, la escritura, la comunicación o el comercio.

rules.effect: You may receive income you did not directly work for, or earn in an unusual way.
rules.effect_es: Puedes recibir ingresos por los que no trabajaste directamente, o ganar de forma poco común.

rules.effect: You may come across hidden wealth, such as a find connected with land or property.
rules.effect_es: Podrías encontrar riqueza oculta, como un hallazgo ligado a tierras o propiedades.
rules.timing_note: One worked chart only; the author rejects the traditional treasure rules (line 2020-2046).

rules.effect: Buying property tends to happen when your running time periods point to home, gain and outlay together.
rules.effect_es: Comprar una propiedad suele ocurrir cuando tus periodos de tiempo en curso apuntan a hogar, ganancia y desembolso.

rules.effect: You are likely to marry during a period ruled by influences tied to family, romance, partnership and fulfilment.
rules.effect_es: Es probable que te cases durante un periodo regido por influencias ligados a la familia, el romance, la pareja y la realización de deseos.
rules.timing_note: Book: main-period lord must give results of 2, 5, 7, 11; sub-period lord must be connected with 7. Transit of period lords, Sun and Moon must also agree (not encoded).

rules.effect: You tend to gain from speculation and games of chance.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a ganar con la especulación y los juegos de azar.
rules.timing_note: Dynamics table: gambling gain read from the sub lord of the 5th cusp signifying 2, 6, 11.

rules.effect: You can gain from sports and contests where chance plays a part.

rules.effect: You can earn your living from speculation, sport or the creative arts.
rules.effect_es: Puedes ganarte la vida con la especulación, el deporte o las artes creativas.

rules.effect: Sudden, unexpected money can come your way.
rules.effect_es: Puede llegarte dinero repentino e inesperado.

rules.effect: You can receive money you did not work for, such as loans, inheritances or other unearned sums.
rules.effect_es: Puedes recibir dinero por el que no trabajaste, como préstamos, herencias u otras sumas no ganadas.

rules.effect: You can see a sudden profit.

rules.effect: Money can arrive suddenly and without much effort.
rules.effect_es: El dinero puede llegar de repente y sin mucho esfuerzo.

rules.effect_es: Puedes tener ingresos por los que no trabajaste ni te esforzaste.

rules.effect: A running period like this favours success in speculative business.
rules.effect_es: Una etapa así favorece el éxito en los negocios especulativos.
rules.timing_note: Table reads: running planet signifies 2,5,10 while its sub lord signifies 11; approximated as the sub-period lord signifying all four.
